# ADR-3252: AWS security_groups:  overlapping world-open rules for alb SG 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Duplicate opens complicate audits.

## Decision

ALB groups SHALL NOT keep overlapping world-open rules for alb SG 4 (AWS-security_groups-4) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Only 80/443 from the world when is expected to.
